texts.What sparked your interest in Spade?: Candid disclosure first: this application was prepared by my own Claude agent fleet under my direction, from my verified bio - building and operating that fleet in public is my core work (github.com/tonydzi). Spade itself is the draw: I spent a decade turning messy, adversarial financial data into decisions (exchange infrastructure, market-maker engines, anti-fraud) with an MSc in information-systems security - 'messy transaction data into structured, verified records' is exactly the problem I want to keep solving.
